settingChatMemory.guide:
1) Fixed memory is yours — the assistant can also append entries (#1, #2, …) via its built-in tool, and automatic summarization never rewrites it.
2) Dynamic memory is distilled incrementally from topic compaction summaries; you can edit, regenerate, or restore the previous version at any time.
3) Topic compaction requires Limit history messages and Summarize history in Chat preferences; in chat, click the green usage badge to inspect usage, view the topic summary, and compact manually.

settingChatMemory.restoreSuccess: Previous dynamic memory restored (click again to undo the restore).
settingChatMemory.rollupConfirmDesc: This re-reads every topic compaction summary and rewrites the dynamic memory. The current content is kept as the previous version and can be restored at any time. Continue?

settingChatMemory.rollupNoChanges: No new durable information in the topic summaries — dynamic memory left unchanged.
settingChatMemory.rollupSkipped: No topic compaction summaries found. Enable compress/history on topics first.
